efficacy_randomised_assignment_source.description: Controlled choice of planned randomised treatment versus actual treatment as the efficacy grouping source for missing-data sensitivity analyses.

planned_assignment_mi_inputs.description: MI-specific copies that preserve actual treatment as context while using planned randomised assignment for the rbmi grouping field.

subject_level_mi_assignment.description: Planned-randomisation grouping for the controlled subject-level MAR/delta rbmi sensitivity analyses.

reference_based_mi_assignment.description: Planned-randomisation grouping for MAR/JR/CR/CIR reference-based rbmi sensitivity analyses and discontinuation/ICE classification.

primary_mmrm_assignment_guard.description: Blocking check that a planned-versus-actual mismatch subject cannot silently enter the observed primary MMRM under the current public-data analysis definition.

mi_assignment_post_execution_audit.description: Post-rbmi verification that executed pairwise target counts follow the planned randomised allocation and that the complete reference-based sensitivity set remains valid.
